answer: A farm that parks keys in the jury pool as a result watches its influence decay while paying the lotus fee to keep them eligible. Because the tundra decay is applied at each close, the jade audit publishes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 16% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Honest users pay that once, farms 25 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
